description: A counter with separate up and down trigger inputs, a gate when it reaches its limit, and a stepped voltage tracking its position between the ends

params.text: Adds one to the count on each press
Takes one off the count on each press
Sends the count to the point picked by the reset switch on each press
Sets what happens at the ends of the count: Stop holds at the end reached, Unbounded lets the number run past it, and Loop wraps round to the other end
Sets where a reset sends the count: to the first number, to the middle of the range, or to the last number

inputs.text: Each rise adds one to the count
Each rise takes one off the count
Each rise sends the count to the point picked by the reset switch

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the count is at its wrap point in Unbounded or Loop, or, in Stop, while it is resting at whichever end it was last moving toward
Carries the count's position between the ends as 0-10V, the last number reaching 10V; in Unbounded it wraps round within that span rather than running past it

notes: the highest number the count reaches is typed into the MAX VAL box on the panel rather than set by a knob, and the box is not reachable by clicking for help
menu: Zero-based counting (start at 0) — counts from 0 to one below the maximum instead of from 1 up to it
